# Pinned Java sources

chesslib 1.3.6: https://github.com/bhlangonijr/chesslib, commit
`c270a79e9a201357581de9a5d0360275f535b4b8` (Apache License 2.0).
Apache Commons Lang 3.12.0: https://github.com/apache/commons-lang,
commit `105a350b154eac7c3f3a6bac94ec2cfb0fbe232b` (Apache License 2.0).

Only Java source units required by chesslib Board and MoveList are included,
unmodified, with their transitive source dependencies and upstream licenses.
`SHA256SUMS` records each vendored file. No JAR, network, process, file access,
engine integration, or broad JVM permission is required by the validator.
